verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a `--headless` mode for running without a UI under external API control, plus batch CLI operations: `--convert-to` with `--outdir`, `--cat` (which implies headless), `--print-to-file`, macro invocation, UNO accept strings, and `-env` to set a non-default user profile. A community user independently confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific guidance (exit codes, concurrent-instance handling) and hands-on evidence of use in an actual CI pipeline rather than Docker generally.
